subject: Apply debug-mode before other module args (#1562)
reason: The change affects only ModuleConfigManager::ParseAndLoadArgv, which runs once at module load over the arguments written after the module's path on the loadmodule directive: it applies --debug-mode in a first pass so Dev() configs given before it on the command line no longer fail the load, and a repeated --debug-mode applies its last value to all arguments. The fuzzer cannot supply module load-time arguments: valkey.action.commands loads modules and modules_parent as bare paths (--loadmodule each), a deployment's server_config.loadmodule is likewise a bare path whose value is one argument, MO
